method: Manual visual reading of pdfjs PNG renderings; wasmUrl=node_modules/pdfjs-dist/wasm/. Ranks are printed ranks, page is the gazette page number. Uncertain complete rosters omitted under the owner-approved per-list fallback; no guessed names published. Punctuation in confirmed names follows the scan. Archived primary CEC candidate HTML additionally resolved UTJ/Shas spellings and Kadima line wrapping; all consulted URLs and captured names are retained in candidates-archive.crosscheck.json. Elected-rank review: candidate and section 4 results scans rendered at scale 4 with pdfjs-dist 6.5.438 and local wasmUrl; visually compared name by name. Every winning list retains at least ranks 1..seats. Later unresolved ranks do not suppress a verified prefix. Results spellings and explicit variants are retained separately in electedCrossCheck; no secondary transcription supplies the new published names.
